overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Bahera Powder as a fine milled botanical ingredient for B2B buyers. We process Terminalia bellirica fruit into a consistent powder with 80–100 mesh size and moisture below 8.0%. It is produced in India for bulk supply, OEM use, and private label requirements.

Our process follows six controlled steps: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. We are an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, with export documentation support available. Samples can be arranged on request, along with custom mesh and packaging options.
